name: Dumaitis
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: Continental Celtic god known only from a single inscription

text: Dumaitis was a Continental Celtic god from Gaul. He remains an obscure figure in Celtic religion. The invading Romans identified him with their god Mercury. Scholars know Dumaitis only from a single inscription. No other record of his cult survives. Romans matched unknown local gods to their own pantheon. Mercury filled that role for Dumaitis. The one inscription provides the only evidence of his worship.
